title: Console requests objects the stock boot does not register: sys_package_installation and sys_user_device answer 404 on every load of their pages
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced on a public entry (reach below).

QA-source: #32135 · browser walk (runner C) · observed beside the clauses
Batch-of: objectstack-ai/objectstack#32135 follow-ups, 15 cards filed on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」

## What we saw

Reach: the stock showcase console at framework ff04ad81.
- Setup → System Overview requests `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_package_installation` → 404 on every load.
- A user record page requests `GET /api/v1/data/sys_user_device` → 404.
- `GET /api/v1/meta/view/OBJECT.default/layers` → 404 in Studio's Interfaces pillar before a default view exists.
- Deleting a record from its record page fires three 404s (`/page`, `/field-access`, `/approvals/records/…/lock`) as the page refetches the deleted record before leaving.

## Proposed change

Ask only for objects the boot registered (from the served object list or discovery), treat a not-yet-existing default view as empty without a request, and navigate away before refetching a deleted record.

## Business reason

Who: every admin; the console error log fills with 404s, hiding real failures.

## Reader

Triage first touch; lands in `ui/` (Setup overview, user record page, Studio interfaces, record-page delete flow).

## Duplicate check

`is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack sys_package_installation 404` (6, open and closed: QA run records and #13457, none on this request) and `sys_user_device` (5: the push-device registry cards #29041, #29068, #29768, none on the console requesting it on a stock boot). Cloud has its own card for hosted-only routes, objectstack-ai/cloud#4300.
